programme.title: Inheriting Devotion: Living on the Pamir Plateau
programme.desc: The towering Pamir Plateau is the homeland of the Tajik people. Every household stands as a guardian of the border, and Longjike Kader's family is no exception. For four generations, they have walked every inch of this rugged land, guarding the nation's frontier for over seventy years. Through it all, they have witnessed not only the growing prosperity of their country but also the quiet, beautiful transformation of their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: Fuding—the land of white tea— is the perfect place for Foodwise hosts Tianran and Hannah to spend the Dragon Boat Festival. Watch them wrap sticky rice dumplings called zongzi, feast on a variety of local snacks and experience the ultimate white tea banquet. From the sea to the mountains, every stop promises a new taste of Fujian.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their travels in Fujian province, this time they visit the birthplace of oolong tea. There's plenty to do, from tasting local specialties like rock tea and braised goose to bamboo rafting and hiking Tianyou Peak. To cap it all off, they'll attend a Zhu Xi banquet, named after one of China's greatest Neo-Confucian scholars.

programme.title: My Village is a National Treasure Ep.3
programme.desc: Dingcun village in Shanxi has a deep cultural legacy borne from a long historical tradition. Yet despite its rich resources, the village remained stagnant for years, described by local scholars as “begging for food while holding a golden bowl.” Now, Dingcun is charting a new course, developing its rural tourism by embracing its unique cultural assets.

programme.title: Grand Feasts Ep.1
programme.desc: Local culinary traditions and unique ingredients offer a window into the thriving lives of revitalized Chinese villages.

programme.title: Song of the Yellow River Ep.5
programme.desc: Focusing on the Yellow River, the mother river of the Chinese nation, celebrate the civilization it nurtured, the ecological challenges it faces, and the wisdom of those who protect its banks.
